scope: Charles River south bank behind GSU, Marsh/CAS and Silber Way, with existing MassGIS roadway/shoreline continuation toward Harvard Bridge to avoid a new road dead end; no expansion to the complete river transport network

primarySources.use: Unchanged road axes and inventory carriageway widths; cached bu-massgis-roads.geojson / bu-road-data.ts
Cached massgis-hydrography.json polygon 14934 south shore vertices 63–94; 1:25,000 scale, not a detailed contemporary shore survey
Silber Way via Back Street, switchback footbridge over Storrow and connection to Charles River path
Distinguishes Bay State Road footbridge behind Marsh and additional Silber Way footbridge
BU Beach is lawn separated from river by Storrow, with a grassy berm

coordinatePolicy: No source road translation or rescaling. Source axes clipped only at x[-1510,400]. Core road detailing ends near Silber; asphalt/markings continue through the existing eastern source segments. South bank uses original lon/lat projected through the existing Cambridge coordinate transform.
authoredApproximations: Exact footbridge switchback outlines were not obtained; route existence/location follows BU references, deck/ramp stations are authored within the measured shore-road-campus corridor.
Footbridges are 3m wide with modeled 4.8m minimum road clearance and 0.32m structural thickness. These dimensions are not engineering survey data.
Riverside path uses an 8m inland offset from the hydrographic shore, plus explicit land-side approaches. Path width and exact edges are not surveyed.

The eastern walking connection follows the existing Harvard Bridge west sidewalk then an authored short descent to the river-side promenade; its ramp and railing opening are not surveyed. Remaining Harvard Bridge and eastern road vertical profiles retain the existing prototype elevations.
No imagery downloaded: official MassGIS ortho request failed DNS and its approval attempt was interrupted. No measurements from unavailable imagery are claimed.

End elevations follow shared buElevation, using the current USGS 3DEP core DEM. Deck stations remain elevated; no whole-bridge terrain drape. Very low path samples use 0.79m ground minimum to avoid old shoreline/DEM water-edge mismatch.
outOfScope: Complete Storrow ramps east of Silber Way
